items.title: Master and internal user accounts reset on Amazon OpenSearch Service: why snapshots don't restore them, and what to prepare
items.content_text: On an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain with fine-grained access control, the master user password may stop working and your internal users and role mappings may disappear. Hourly automated snapshots do not bring this data back, because the official restore procedure excludes the security system index that holds it. This article explains why, what recovery is possible, and what to prepare beforehand. It is intended for operators of such domains.

This article demonstrates how AWS Continuum's capabilities map across these workload types with a complete implementation walkthrough of pen testing an embedded QuickSight application — helping practitioners secure their entire stack, not just their web tier.

items.title: How I troubleshoot Amazon Bedrock Guardrails throttling (`ThrottlingException` / "Too many requests")
items.content_text: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails throttles on three independent quota dimensions — requests per second, text units per second per policy, and maximum input size per request. This article shows how to tell which limit you hit from the error message, how to confirm it with CloudWatch metrics and Service Quotas, and which Guardrails quotas you can raise yourself versus which are hard limits.

items.title: When should I consider reducing JVM heap size on Amazon OpenSearch Service for better search performance?
items.content_text: On larger Amazon OpenSearch Service instance types, JVM heap may be configured above 32 GiB. For certain workload types — particularly search-heavy and vector search workloads — a smaller heap can improve performance. This article provides general guidance on how to evaluate whether adjusting JVM heap benefits your domain.

items.title: Automate AWS DevOps Agent Onboarding at the OU Level Using StackSets and EventBridge
items.content_text: Adopting Amazon DevOps Agent across multiple AWS accounts requires deploying an IAM role and creating an association for each secondary account. StackSets automates the IAM role but cannot create associations leaving a manual gap. This article eliminates that gap using StackSets, EventBridge and Lambda for zero-touch onboarding: when an account joins a target OU, the role deploys automatically and the association is created within ~3 minutes with no human intervention.

items.title: Redshift Spectrum query fails with a syntax error while the same query succeeds in Athena - reserved word differences between engines (nested struct)
items.content_text: When you query the same AWS Glue Data Catalog external table from both Amazon Athena and Amazon Redshift Spectrum, an identical SELECT statement can succeed in Athena but fail in Redshift Spectrum with `syntax error at or near "..."`. This happens because the two engines have different reserved word lists, and it is especially easy to miss inside a nested struct path. This article shows data engineers who use both engines how to identify the cause and fix it.

items.title: Troubleshooting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway Connection Issues with Amazon Connect Customer AI Agents
items.content_text: Amazon Connect AI Agents reach business systems through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway as MCP tools. When any link in that chain is misconfigured, nothing errors: the gateway namespace simply never appears, even though every setup step reports success. This guide gives Connect admins and engineers the eight root causes in triage order, with the console fields, CLI commands and logs that confirm each, plus a decision flow, verification steps and a checklist.
